content_evaluation_contract.market_data: no market odds or popularity in ability evaluation

content_evaluation_contract.history_window: use four verified merged runs; add older factual racing evidence only where source and as-of are certain
content_evaluation_contract.incident_guard: never infer an unverified break, interference, or wide trip
